title: Parkio Daily for Tuesday, November 24, 2026
teaser: Twilight Tales safari debuts at Animal Kingdom; Big Thunder and Haunted Mansion both down this morning at Magic Kingdom.

breaking.title: Big Thunder Mountain and Haunted Mansion both failed to open this morning
breaking.body: Two of Magic Kingdom's highest-capacity attractions remained closed through midday Monday as Thanksgiving week crowds arrived. No reopening time has been announced for either ride.

parkioInsight.text: Frontierland and Liberty Square tend to bottleneck fast when these two are down. Prioritizing Tomorrowland or Fantasyland during the first few hours usually avoids the worst congestion.

breaking.title: Twilight Tales nighttime safari launching at Animal Kingdom
breaking.body: A new after-dark version of Kilimanjaro Safaris called Twilight Tales is coming to Animal Kingdom. The experience will offer a different narrative and lighting setup for evening guests.

parkioInsight.text: Evening safari slots tend to book quickly once word spreads. Guests visiting Animal Kingdom today may find shorter waits for the daytime safari while others queue for the new twilight version.

bignews.title: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova debut at Avengers Campus
bignews.body: Two new characters from Avengers: Doomsday are now meeting guests at Disney California Adventure ahead of the film's December 18 release. Additional interactive experiences tied to the movie will roll out through the holiday season.

parkioInsight.text: Character debuts typically draw long queues in the first few days. Arriving at Avengers Campus right at park opening or during the dinner hour often yields shorter meet-and-greet waits.

bignews.title: Half of Disneyland's new security screening area now open
bignews.body: Construction barriers have come down around the first phase of the expanded security checkpoint in the Esplanade. Guests can now walk under the new awning, though the second half remains under construction.

parkioInsight.text: The new lanes may speed entry during peak arrival windows. Guests rope-dropping Disneyland this week often benefit from testing the expanded checkpoint rather than older lanes.

bignews.title: Gideon's Bakehouse switches to Ghirardelli chocolate and renames signature cookie
bignews.body: The Disney Springs bakery is changing its chocolate chip supplier and renaming its flagship chocolate chip cookie to The Maximus. The recipe adjustment takes effect immediately.

parkioInsight.text: Recipe changes at Gideon's tend to spark curiosity rushes. Visiting Disney Springs before 11am today usually means shorter waits and better cookie availability.

bignews.title: Animal Kingdom adds surprise late hours through early 2027
bignews.body: Disney World extended operating hours at Animal Kingdom for Christmas week 2026 and into January 2027, joining previously announced extensions at Magic Kingdom and Hollywood Studios.

parkioInsight.text: Late-night hours at Animal Kingdom are rare and tend to thin crowds significantly after 8pm. Guests visiting during the holiday stretch may find Flight of Passage and Everest nearly walk-on after sunset.

topstories.title: Lightning Lane Premier Pass selling out at record-high prices
topstories.body: The top-tier skip-the-line product has sold out across all four Disney World parks for nearly a full week ahead of Thanksgiving, with Magic Kingdom pricing hitting new highs. Single-day Lightning Lane is also unavailable.

parkioInsight.text: Sellouts of paid line-skip typically signal very heavy attendance. Guests without Lightning Lane this week should prioritize rope drop and plan for standby waits over 60 minutes at headliners.

topstories.title: Magic Kingdom and Hollywood Studios blocked out for many annual passholders
topstories.body: Half of Disney World's parks are unavailable to most pass types during Thanksgiving week, with blockout dates in effect before the holiday itself.

parkioInsight.text: Blockouts concentrate crowds at EPCOT and Animal Kingdom. Passholders visiting this week often find better ride availability at those two parks, especially mid-afternoon.

topstories.title: Imagineers reveal more details about Indiana Jones ride replacing DINOSAUR
topstories.body: Indiana Jones and the Myth of the Jade Serpent will open in 2027 as part of the new Tropical Americas land at Animal Kingdom. Disney shared fresh story and setting information for the rethemed attraction.

parkioInsight.text: DINOSAUR is likely running its final season. Guests who want one last ride before the retheme should visit Animal Kingdom in the next few months, as closure timing may be announced soon.

topstories.title: Coco ride construction ramps up at Disney California Adventure
topstories.body: Large structural elements and additional materials have arrived at the future Coco attraction site near Disneyland Drive. Activity is visibly increasing along the perimeter.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise and equipment can be noticeable near Paradise Gardens. Guests sensitive to construction activity may want to focus on the opposite side of the park during daytime hours.

topstories.title: Disney Cruise Line replaces gingerbread houses with towers across fleet
topstories.body: The holiday gingerbread displays on Disney's classic cruise ships are now vertical towers instead of the traditional house designs. The change debuts on this season's Very Merrytime sailings.

parkioInsight.text: Gingerbread displays tend to draw photo crowds in the first days after installation. Guests sailing this week may find shorter lines for photos early in the morning or late at night.

topstories.title: BoardWalk Inn facing refurbishment in early 2027
topstories.body: Experts are advising guests to avoid booking Disney's BoardWalk Inn for early 2027 due to planned work at the resort.

parkioInsight.text: Refurbishments at Deluxe resorts often bring noise and reduced amenities. Guests with early 2027 trips may want to consider Beach Club or Yacht Club for similar EPCOT-area access without construction.

icymi.title: Starbucks at Disneyland Paris Village closed through November 27
icymi.body: The coffeehouse in Disney Village is under renovation and will remain closed for the rest of this week.

icymi.title: One-day Disney World tickets could hit 334 dollars by 2035
icymi.body: A market analysis projects that the most expensive single-day Magic Kingdom admission could exceed 330 dollars within a decade, based on current year-over-year price increases.

icymi.title: Hallmark's Disney World Christmas movie premieres this week
icymi.body: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True debuts as Hallmark's first movie filmed at Walt Disney World. The film was shot overnight across multiple park locations.

icymi.title: New Disneyland sepia Spirit Jersey features vintage park photos
icymi.body: A brown pullover with beige designs and sepia-toned images of Disneyland icons is now available at the resort for 84.99 dollars.

spotlight.title: Disney's Wonderful World of Disney: Holiday Spectacular airs November 30
spotlight.body: The annual holiday special returns to television on Monday, November 30, with a star-studded music lineup filmed across Walt Disney World. The broadcast features performances and park highlights from Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, and other resort locations.

parkioInsight.text: Holiday filming often closes sections of the parks for taping. Guests visiting in late November may encounter brief reroutes but can also catch glimpses of celebrity talent and production crews around the resort.
